entries.01777e45203d94ca: This is a single-segment business centered on operating a restaurant information website, supporting restaurants in attracting customers and managing their businesses. The company and three consolidated subsidiaries (Gurunavi Support Associe Co., Ltd., G Dining Co., Ltd. and Gutu Mami (Shanghai) Information Consulting Co., Ltd.) make up the group, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,132 million.
entries.04f8d646fdcb47a0: This business supports government ministries and local governments in promoting regional food culture and revitalizing regions, and carries out promotions for food and beverage manufacturers using the network of restaurants and consumers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,225 million.
entries.1202047bd4e011e0: This business comprises the kitchen equipment retail store "Tempos Gurunavi", the tourist information service for inbound foreign visitors "LIVE JAPAN", an EC site handling meal kits and gift products, store development such as producing food floors in commercial facilities and operating direct-managed stores, the corporate gourmet membership service "PREMIUM GOURMET CLUB", and promotional support overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,787 million.
entries.8a30733fe2a2b612: A service that combines a foundation service, which lists restaurant information on the restaurant information site "Rakuten Gurunavi" and accepts online reservations, with business support such as Gurunavi PRO, Gurunavi Ledger and Gurunavi FineOrder, and a marketing agency that runs various promotional media on the company's behalf. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,119 million.
entries.ec1753b9dfff4302: A company that operates the restaurant information site "Rakuten Gurunavi," supports restaurants in attracting customers and in management, and provides food promotion for local governments and manufacturers.
